question_text: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the 2020 Census of Population and Housing (CPH) recorded a total population of 109,035,343, an increase of 8,045,613 from the 2015 census. The population grew at an average annual rate of 1.63% from 2015 to 2020, lower than the 1.72% rate from 2010 to 2015. The most populous region was CALABARZON with 16.2 million, followed by the National Capital Region (NCR) with 13.5 million. What was the population of the Philippines according to the 2015 census?
